jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Senior Director, Product Design to join our team. In this role, you’ll lead and actively contribute to the creation of customer-centered concepts, prototypes, and front-end experiences across the full spectrum of design – from low-fidelity exploration through to high-fidelity, production-ready outputs – and be expected to work fluidly across that range.

At Runyon, Product Design is evolving – not just in what we make, but in how we make it. We’re moving closer to build, bringing design into implementation, and exploring how AI and emerging tools can accelerate how ideas are generated, tested, and brought to life. This role will play a key part in shaping that direction – both through the work itself and in how we continue to evolve our craft.

You’ll operate as part of a cross-disciplinary leadership team, with shared ownership over the work and its direction – shaping decisions, setting the bar for craft, and bringing new products and experiences to life alongside peers across research, strategy, and product.

You bring a strong point of view on product design, grounded in deep empathy for user needs and behaviors, and a clear understanding of how to leverage research to inform design decisions. You are able to translate insights into thoughtful, well-crafted experiences that reflect business model considerations, brand expression, and growth strategy within the user flows you shape.

About Runyon

We are a product design and venture studio that helps companies grow.

  • We're prototyping-led. We lead with tangible assumptions in the form of prototypes and test them with real stakeholders to validate and refine our strategy and design. Regardless of discipline, we think and communicate in concepts, and use those to move further, faster.
  • We're detailed and intentional. We always back up our design decisions with sound reasoning—be it user research, market research, or both. We make things that make sense and that have a clear through line.
  • We're fast. We work almost exclusively in sprints, and with lean teams. We need folks who like to run.
  • We're collaborative. We jam as a multidisciplinary team of specialists who collectively contribute to the full spectrum of work across user research, strategy and design to arrive at high quality outcomes.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead projects through the lens of product design – ensuring alignment across design, strategy, business, and operational objectives, with project management support as needed
  • Translate insights from qualitative research and strategic design into clear, engaging, and actionable product design – actively shaping user-centered concepts, systems, and interaction models that bring clarity to complex problem spaces
  • Generate and evolve concepts through hands-on design – crafting early hypotheses, low- to high-fidelity concepts, functional prototypes, and exploring multiple paths forward, while guiding the team through iteration and validation
  • Design and deliver strategically grounded, high-quality user flows and interactive prototypes that articulate a compelling vision and demonstrate tangible impact
  • Lead by example in craft – owning and contributing to high-impact product moments, setting the bar for quality through direct design contribution
  • Partner closely with cross-disciplinary teammates (research, strategy, product, engineering) to shape work from initial framing through design delivery and (more recently) build – balancing desirability, viability, and feasibility at every stage
  • Create clear, persuasive narratives and visual storytelling artifacts that communicate the work in an impactful way to both internal teams and senior client partner stakeholders
  • Contribute to the evolution of Product Design at Runyon – exploring and implementing tools, systems, and methodologies that strengthen the craft and improve how we work
  • Mentor and support designers across levels – providing direction, feedback, and hands-on collaboration to elevate both individual growth and team output
  • Help build and shape the team – attracting and engaging top design talent, while reinforcing Runyon’s culture and standards
  • Foster strong, trust-based partnerships across teams – encouraging open dialogue, shared ownership, and a highly collaborative, iterative working style
  • Communicate clearly and persuasively – tailoring design rationale and storytelling to a range of audiences, including senior and executive stakeholders

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 15+ years of experience in product / UX design (or equivalent), with significant experience on an in-house product team; experience within a design studio or agency environment is a strong complement
  • A portfolio that demonstrates exceptional craft across the full design spectrum – from early concepting through to high-fidelity, production-ready outputs – with a clear ability to simplify complex systems into intuitive, elegant experiences
  • Demonstrated strength in both zero-to-one product/service design and/or design systems creation and implementation, with the ability to move fluidly between exploratory and production-ready work
  • Proven ability to rapidly generate and iterate on concepts – translating ideas into tangible artifacts quickly, and refining them into detailed, high-quality design
  • Deep proficiency with contemporary design and prototyping tools and methods (e.g., Figma), including structuring files for wireframes, visual design, interactive prototypes, and scalable design systems
  • Demonstrated depth using AI-powered design and coding tools
  • Strong communication and storytelling skills – able to clearly and persuasively articulate design rationale to a range of audiences, including senior and executive stakeholders
  • A strong point of view on product design, grounded in user empathy, with the ability to connect user needs to business strategy, brand expression, and growth opportunities
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity – with a bias toward action, experimentation, and generating multiple paths to arrive at innovative, differentiated solutions
  • Fluency in emerging tools and technologies – including a growing literacy in AI-enabled design workflows and a working understanding of how products are built (code, systems, and technical constraints)
  • Equally comfortable leading and contributing, with a willingness to roll up your sleeves and drive the work forward through direct execution
  • Nice to have: Experience working in financial services, fintech, payments, or other complex, regulated domains

This is a remote role open to U.S.-based candidates, with the option to work from our DUMBO studio for those in NYC. This role may require up to 25% travel.

What We're Building:

Clera is reimagining how top talent finds their dream jobs. We're already working with leading VC-backed startups like Mintlify, Luminai, and Windsurf – automating the entire headhunting process end-to-end with AI agents.

Thousands of talents engage with Clera every week. We've helped many land roles at companies they're genuinely excited about. Traditional recruiting is broken – we're fixing it with AI-first automation that delivers better outcomes for both candidates and companies.

We're at the perfect inflection point: early enough that you'll have massive ownership and impact, but far enough that we have a working product, paying customers, and strong traction.

The Role:

You'll be engineer #4 on the founding team, working directly with our CTO and the other founding engineers. You'll ship features to production daily and own entire product areas from concept to deployment.

Tech Stack: TypeScript, React, Cursor, Supabase, Prisma, Typesense, LLM APIs,

The SF Hackerhouse Setup:

We're living and building together in SF. Zero commute, 10× faster feedback loops, constant collaboration.

It's intense, but it's also incredibly productive and fun. You'll be surrounded by A-players who are all-in on building something great.

Why Join Now:

If you're the kind of engineer who wants to build fast, own outcomes, and create something that matters – let's talk.

jobs.excerpt: We've heard about “patient-led care” for ages, but now AI has infinite time, and peptides are for sale on Telegram.
jobs.description:
We've heard about “patient-led care” for ages, but now AI has infinite time, and peptides are for sale on Telegram. This time it's happening.

AI reads every research paper ever published, has infinite time for you, and runs doctors like specialized subcontractors. GLP-1s deliver lasting behavior change and health gains with minimal effort, practically magic. Add online communities and gray-market supply chains, and individuals are rewriting health care faster than regulators can blink.

Finnrick is the architect of trust in that chaos.

We started by testing peptides for free: anyone can mail us a vial, we publish the lab truth in a public, ranked database. The data exposes fakes, burns bad labs, and crowns reliable supply chains. We're already forcing safer products across the market.

The hard part: forging trust in a zero-trust world, where every sample could be tampered with and both vendors and labs have motive to lie. We chain-of-custody every gram, cross-validate labs, and ship transparency at scale in a space that punishes honesty.

We fund the mission by supporting vendors who want to win, and offering premium options to the newly sovereign public.

If you build systems that turn chaos into signal, come make the signal louder.

Community Engagement Lead - Gray-Market Whisperer
Austin, TX or Remote (US preferred)

(One of the first 10 hires, reports straight to founders)

You live online.

You speak fluent Reddit, X, TikTok, Telegram, and the private Discords where peptides actually move. You’ve pinned, dosed, or at least obsessively tracked GLP-1s, BPC-157, or some research-grade unicorn. Memes are your native tongue; you smell astroturf a mile off.

The job is simple on paper, brutal in practice:

Be Finnrick’s voice inside every peptide tribe—MAGA iron addicts, tinfoil biohackers, autistic data monks, and literal PhDs—without ever picking a side. You translate lab reports into shitposts, calm flame wars with chain-of-custody receipts, and turn lurkers into mail-in testers. One hour you’re debunking a vendor in a 4chan thread, the next you’re live on TikTok injecting saline for transparency theater.

What you’ll ship in 90 days

  • A cross-platform content engine that turns HPLC graphs into viral hooks
  • Email sequences that feel like DMs from a trusted plug, not a newsletter
  • Real-time intel dashboard tracking every new peptide Telegram drop and Reddit ban wave
  • A meme lexicon that makes “third-party tested” cooler than “research only”

Hard mode (this is the filter)

  • You must earn trust from people who trust no one.
  • You’ll be ratioed by shills, doxx-threatened by vendors, and nitpicked by spectrum geniuses who cite 40-year-old rodent studies.
  • You’ll still keep every faction sending vials.

Must-haves

  • Ran a channel that broke 50k engaged (any platform)
  • Can cut a 15-second TikTok and a 2-hour breakdown video
  • Used peptides yourself: stack, purpose, source don’t matter
  • AI prompt wizardry without sounding like ChatGPT
  • CET to CT time zones, US preferred

Pay & perks

$85-125k · 0.3-0.6% equity · full health · pick your tools · Austin HQ or remote (travel 4x/year)

Apply

DM @finnrick_tests on X with one meme that explains why Finnrick’s database matters and a 2-sentence war story from a community you’ve wrangled. No résumé, no cover letter. We’ll know.

Salary: $85,000 – $125,000 / year

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.excerpt: Ajaia is an AI implementation consultancy and product studio.
jobs.description:
Ajaia is an AI implementation consultancy and product studio. We help organizations move from AI experimentation to measurable return on investment across four practices: AI Strategy and Advisory, Workforce Training and Enablement, Process Optimization, and Custom AI Development. Our work sits with executives and the people who do the work, and it is judged on whether something changed in production, not on whether a pilot looked good in a deck.

Position Overview
Ajaia is hiring a remote Product Manager to own products in Ajaia's product suite end to end. You will talk to users and customers every week, decide what gets built next and why, and say plainly what does not get built, including when the loudest voice in the room wants it. You will write specs an engineer can build from without a follow-up meeting, prototype with AI tools when a working demo settles an argument faster than a deck, and stay on the number after launch and act on what it tells you. This is a builder's seat: you will contribute to the code and the design yourself, not only direct them.

You will work with a US-based team and US clients. Most of your users, stakeholders, and engineers sit in New York, so this role is built around daily overlap with US Eastern hours, not asynchronous handoffs.

Compensation: Competitive, benchmarked to senior product roles in your market, plus a performance bonus tied to product outcomes. We will share a specific number for your location early in the process.

How we expect you to work
AI use is a core execution requirement at Ajaia, not optional tooling. You will use AI daily to sort through usage data, draft specs, and build working prototypes yourself, and you are judged on what you keep from that output, not on how much of it you generated. The tools change fast, and staying current on what is worth using is part of the job.

Remote works here when the writing is strong. Decisions, specs, and priority calls get written down where the team can read them, not held in your head until the next call.

What you will do

  • Talk to users and customers every week. Not a quarterly survey. Real conversations, real usage, on US time.
  • Turn messy, sometimes contradictory signal, usage data, support tickets, sales requests, and what people say in interviews, into a ranked call on what gets built next.
  • Say plainly what does not get built, including a well-funded customer's request, when the evidence does not support it.
  • Write specs an engineer can build from without a follow-up meeting: the outcome, what is in and out of scope, where a human stays in the loop, and acceptance criteria someone could test.
  • Prototype the core flow yourself, wireframes, a clickable mock, or a working demo, when that settles the argument faster than a deck would.
  • Contribute to the code and the design directly: ship a small feature or fix with AI tools, mock the screen yourself, and hand engineers something running instead of something described.
  • Partner with the design team on what the solution should be and how it holds up for the people using it.
  • Partner with the delivery team and engineers on how the build runs and the date it ships by.
  • Present the roadmap and the tradeoffs to the people who fund it, including when a client or a salesperson is unhappy with the call.
  • Hold a priority decision under real pushback, or change it, and say why either way.
  • Ship it, then watch the number after launch and act on what it says.

Requirements

  • Highly organized across multiple priorities and open questions at once.
  • Sharp judgment on what to build next, and clear about what not to build.
  • Strong plain written and spoken English: specs and decisions other people can act on without a follow-up meeting, and customer calls you can run without a translator.
  • AI fluent: you use AI daily to sort signal, draft specs, and prototype, and you can tell good output from slop.
  • Comfortable contributing to code and design directly, with AI tools making you faster at both.
  • Comfortable holding a priority call under pushback, or changing it for stated reasons.
  • 1 or more years in product management, or work that proves the same skill.
  • Available for at least 7 to 8 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern time (9am to 6pm ET), consistently.
  • Reliable internet, a quiet place to take customer calls, and your own laptop.
  • Legally able to work as an independent contractor or through an employer of record in your country.
  • A bachelor's degree is preferred and is not a requirement.

Nice to have

  • Prior experience working remotely with a US or UK team.
  • Experience with a B2B product used by an operational or compliance function.
  • Comfort reading usage data or a support queue yourself.
  • Exposure to a regulated industry such as financial services, insurance, healthcare, or legal.
  • Prior experience in a 0-to-1 or early-stage product role.

Benefits

Competitive benefits.

About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom's role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

This role owns email and lifecycle marketing across three properties: Shadow, Darkroom, and our CEO's personal newsletter. Our marketing team publishes a high volume of content across LinkedIn, X, Instagram, YouTube, a podcast, and a creator program, and very little of it has an email path behind it. You build that path and then run it.

Shadow is the priority. It needs a direct funnel that takes someone from a creator post or a LinkedIn post into an email sequence and through to a signup, and that funnel does not exist today. Darkroom is second: prospect and client nurture by service line, plus the biweekly newsletter. Third is the CEO's newsletter, where the job is turning a large LinkedIn and X audience into an owned list.

This is a B2B lifecycle role and that is the part we care about most. The purchase is considered, the cycle runs over weeks, and more than one person is involved in the decision. You will report to the VP of Marketing and work alongside a designer, a video editor, and a Marketing Ops & Social Media Manager who handles publishing and deployment, plus an AI analytics layer that handles dashboards. Design and video are not your job. You own the strategy, the flows, and the copy, and you run webinars and demo follow-up end to end, briefing the designer and video editor for the assets you need. This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone, and we are hiring for it in Brazil, Portugal, and Spain.

Please note: this is a talent pool as we are not actively hiring for this role right now. Strong fits will be contacted once the role is open.

What You'll Do

Shadow Lifecycle (priority)

  • Build the direct funnel end to end: creator or LinkedIn post, to email capture, to nurture, to signup, instrumented so we know which content produces signups.

  • Own onboarding, activation, and product education sequences for new Shadow signups.

  • Run follow-up for demos, webinars, and launches, with the sequence built before the event rather than after it.

Darkroom and the CEO's Newsletter

  • Build prospect and client nurture by service line, so a lead from a case study or an event lands in a sequence that matches what brought them in.

  • Own the strategy behind the biweekly newsletter, working with the Marketing Ops Manager who deploys it.

  • Turn the CEO's LinkedIn and X audience into an owned list: capture, welcome sequence, cadence, and a format that holds attention.

  • Keep the sales team supplied with follow-up sequences they will actually use.

Lists, Copy, and Reporting

  • Own segmentation, list hygiene, deliverability, and compliance across all three properties.

  • Write your own copy. In this role the person who writes the email and the person who builds the flow are the same person.

  • Report on what each flow produces in signups and pipeline, not only in opens and clicks.

  • Document the flows so they live in a system the team can see and run.

What We're Looking For

  • A real understanding of B2B. This is the most important thing on this list. The job is moving someone from a first touch to a signup or a sales conversation over weeks, with several people involved in the decision.

  • Genuine experience building lifecycle or email programs yourself. Years matter less than whether you built the flows rather than briefing them to someone else.

  • Platform-agnostic. We use Substack today and may use Mailchimp, Klaviyo, HubSpot, or beehiiv depending on the property. Knowing how lifecycle marketing works matters more than knowing one tool.

  • Smart in a way that shows up in the work. You can look at a funnel, work out where people are dropping off, and write the email that fixes it.

  • Strong writing. Our voice is direct and specific, and you should be able to write in it unsupervised.

  • Able to work across three audiences in the same week: a software audience for Shadow, an agency buyer for Darkroom, and a personal brand audience for the newsletter.

  • AI-native. Our team works alongside AI for analytics, reporting, and drafting, and you should be excited to build workflows with it.

  • Comfortable owning the function from the ground up. Most of these flows do not exist yet.

Bonus Points

  • Hands-on ESP experience: Klaviyo, HubSpot, beehiiv, Substack, Mailchimp.

  • You have marketed a SaaS or software product to a business audience.

  • Agency, ecommerce, or performance marketing background.

  • You have built a newsletter or an owned audience of your own.

  • Familiarity with Notion, our operating layer.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

  • Unlimited PTO + Local holidays (Relevant to your hub): Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.

  • Remote-First Culture: Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include the Brazil and Spain.

  • Parental Leave: Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.

  • Growth: Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

jobs.description:
Who we are

We’re a global, midsize CRO that pushes boundaries, innovates and invents because the path to a cure for the world’s most persistent diseases is not paved by those who play it safe. It is built by those who take pioneering, creative approaches and implement them with quality and excellence.

We are Worldwide Clinical Trials, and we are a global team of over 3,500+ experts, bright thinkers, dreamers and doers and, together, we are changing the way the world experiences CROs – in the best possible way.

Our mission is to work with passion and purpose every day to improve lives and we are looking for others who value this same pursuit.

Why Worldwide

We believe everyone plays an important role in making a world of difference for patients and their caregivers. From our hands-on, accessible leaders, to our cohesive and supportive teams, we are committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed. We prioritize cultivating a diverse and inclusive environment that continues to promote collaboration and creativity. We are proud to be a workplace where people thrive by being themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day. Join us!

What the Clinical Operations Department does at Worldwide

Clinical Research Associates (CRAs) play a vital role in ensuring our clinical research programs are executed with the quality and excellence our sponsors expect and the care and passion patients deserve.

These roles are the backbone of every strong CRO, helping drive breakthrough scientific research and playing a lead role on every clinical trial. All CROs will promise you growth, opportunity and maybe even a challenge. But we offer more than that. We offer an uncommon experience – one you can’t get anywhere else, with a team unlike anyone else.

At Worldwide we balance fun with the serious business of changing lives. We have a values-driven culture that is built from the ground up. We empower our team members to treat every trial like a patient’s life depends on it – because it does. Our leaders are in the trenches with you daily - committed to advancing science and moving mountains for our customers.

What you will do

  • Responsible for site qualification, initiation, interim monitoring, site management,and study close-out visits.

  • Provide mentoring and guidance to less experienced CRAs and site staff when needed.

  • Document site visit findings via written reports.

  • Assess, monitor, and train study site staff on protocol adherence as required.

  • Review study subject safety information and informed consent.

  • Conduct source document verification for compliance, patient safety, and veracity of data.

  • Review CRFs using paper or electronic data capture systems and assist sites with data query resolution.

  • Provide applicable updates for site related documentation for filing in the Trial Master File (TMF).

  • Ensure site compliance with IP receipt, accountability and return or destruction.

  • Conduct accompanied site visits for assessment or training of other CRAs as requested and appropriate.

What you will bring to the role

  • Excellent interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills in English

  • Superior organizational skills with attention to details

  • Ability to work with little or no supervision

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, CTMS and EDC Systems

Your experience

  • 5+ years of experience as a Clinical Research Associate

  • 4-year university degree or RN/BSN in Nursing

  • Willingness to travel required

We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do.

To view our other roles, check out our careers page at Discover a world of difference at Worldwide! For more information on Worldwide, visit or connect with us on LinkedIn.

Worldwide is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed and, to that end, we prioritize attracting diverse talent and cultivating an inclusive environment that encourages collaboration and creativity. We know that when our employees feel appreciated and included, they can be more creative, innovative, and successful. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to creating exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, military status, or other class protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Director of Business Development
jobs.excerpt: Since 2017, Flourish has been on a mission to help financial advisors evolve from holistic advice to holistic implementation to better serve their clients and grow their businesses.
jobs.description:
Since 2017, Flourish has been on a mission to help financial advisors evolve from holistic advice to holistic implementation to better serve their clients and grow their businesses. We focus on independent Registered Investment Advisors (RIAs), delivering financial products that advisors can’t easily access today through beautiful, scalable, and easy-to-use technology.

Today, we work with over 1,100 RIAs that collectively represent more than $2.6T in assets under management across two products: Flourish Cash and Flourish Lending. Headquartered in New York City, we are an independently-operating, wholly-owned subsidiary of MassMutual Life Insurance Company.

Read on if you are interested in joining a dynamic, highly-collaborative, rapidly-growing startup—backed by the support and stability of a Fortune 500 company.

About You

With a passion for sales, finance and technology, you are looking to join a collaborative sales team within a fast-paced startup environment. You are an extremely skilled communicator, both verbally and in writing, and your excellent people skills make you a natural relationship builder. You are organized and can manage multiple work streams in parallel while continuously prioritizing what’s most important. You are a high-output, self-motivated self-starter, able to learn fast and execute while also thriving within a collaborative, team oriented environment.

You are excited to join a fast-paced, financial technology startup, and are motivated by the prospect of joining our sales team. You will be able to seamlessly own and maintain existing relationships with existing Flourish clients, while also being ready to build new relationships with a growing client base of independent RIAs.

About the Role

As a Director of Business Development, you will play a key role on our sales team, working with RIAs to both grow adoption of our products within our existing client base and to bring new firms onto the platform. You’ll work independently to own and manage client conversations from end-to-end, including managing inbound leads and working independently to originate new business opportunities—whether through your own efforts or in partnership with our marketing organization. You’ll partner across the organization to share client feedback, champion innovative business opportunities, and develop new strategies for growth while contributing to the overall sales efforts of Flourish.

As the only member of the sales team based in the western half of the US, you will travel frequently to visit clients and for conferences. You’ll partner across the organization to share client feedback, champion innovative business opportunities, and develop new strategies for growth while contributing to the overall sales efforts of Flourish.

Principal Responsibilities

  • Own and manage client relationships from end-to-end, from sourcing to managing the sales process to client activation and adoption
  • Interact with key clients to understand and resolve complex issues related to the platform
  • Partner with our relationship management team to develop a coverage strategy for existing client relationships
  • Identify and originate new business opportunities, whether through your own actions or in partnership with our marketing organization
  • Manage the sales pipeline and relationships using CRM and partner with the data team to develop and maintain internal reporting tools
  • Collaborate on the development of product and functional strategy for Flourish
  • Willingness to travel for sales pitches and conferences (<50% travel)
  • Stay current on general trends in the financial industry, and specifically within wealth management
  • Maintain excellent communication with internal Flourish stakeholders
  • Exercise considerable judgment and analysis to arrive at recommendations and/or conclusions

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 8+ years of related sales experience
  • Background in financial sales required, with some experience in financial technology strongly preferred
  • Either have a Series 7 or willingness to get a Series 7 within 60 days of joining
  • Position is remote based in the western half of the US including Texas, Colorado, Arizona or California, with California strongly preferred
  • Experience working with Retirement Investment Advisors
  • Due to the nature of this position, as part of the background check process, candidates must be able to pass a fingerprint background check to qualify as a fingerprinted person under FINRA. For roles requiring registration, additional regulatory screenings may apply, including a review of Form U5 disclosures and other relevant licensing information.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working as part of a fast-moving team with minimal guidance
  • Highly comfortable with technology, both personally and professionally
  • Excellent written and verbal communications, both internally and externally
  • Strong problem solver and creative, independent thinker
  • Energetic, positive and charismatic
  • Experience selling to wealth managers or experience at a wealth management firm preferred

At Flourish, we focus on ensuring fair, equitable pay by providing competitive salaries, along with bonus and incentive opportunities and benefits for all employees.

Base Salary Range: $167,800 - $220,200 plus bonus

Disclosures:

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

jobs.excerpt: 📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkhedenAls Cybersecurity Analist Vulnerability Management & Attack Surface Management werk je mee aan de verdere uitbouw, uitvoering en optimalisatie van de dienstverlening rond vulnerability management, attack surface management en cyber awareness binnen de Vlaamse overheid.
jobs.description:
📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Als Cybersecurity Analist Vulnerability Management & Attack Surface Management werk je mee aan de verdere uitbouw, uitvoering en optimalisatie van de dienstverlening rond vulnerability management, attack surface management en cyber awareness binnen de Vlaamse overheid.

Je onderzoekt en beoordeelt informatie over kwetsbaarheden, blootgestelde systemen en beveiligingsrisico's. Je valideert bevindingen, plaatst ze in de juiste risicocontext en vertaalt je analyse naar bruikbare aanbevelingen. Daarbij ondersteun je Vlaamse entiteiten en lokale besturen bij het prioriteren, opvolgen en remediëren van vastgestelde risico's.

Automatisering vormt een belangrijk onderdeel van deze rol. Gezien het grote aantal bronnen, datastromen en doelgroepen ontwikkel en onderhoud je scripts en API-integraties, hoofdzakelijk in Python, voor het verzamelen, verrijken, correleren, opvolgen en rapporteren van kwetsbaarheidsinformatie.

Je stemt regelmatig af met collega's, externe partners en vertegenwoordigers van Vlaamse entiteiten en lokale besturen. Zo help je om kwetsbaarheden en blootgestelde systemen tijdig zichtbaar te maken en organisaties te ondersteunen met duidelijke en toepasbare aanbevelingen.

Daarnaast draag je bij aan initiatieven rond cyber awareness en phishingsimulaties. De functie is sterk operationeel en uitvoerend, en combineert inhoudelijke security-expertise met een actieve rol in de dagelijkse werking van de dienstverlening.

Kerntaken

  • Analyseren van kwetsbaarheden en blootstellingen op basis van uiteenlopende bronnen.
  • Valideren van bevindingen, filteren van ruis en false positives, en inschatten van de werkelijke impact voor betrokken organisaties.
  • Risicogebaseerd prioriteren van bevindingen op basis van onder meer CVSS, EPSS, exploitatiestatus en organisatiecontext.
  • Formuleren van overkoepelende inzichten, trends en organisatiespecifieke aanbevelingen op basis van geanalyseerde informatie.
  • Ontsluiten van bevindingen via geschikte rapporterings- en communicatiekanalen, afgestemd op zowel technische als niet-technische doelgroepen.
  • Ontwikkelen en onderhouden van scripts en API-integraties in Python voor dataverzameling, verrijking, correlatie en rapportering.
  • Ondersteunen van de opvolging van remediatieacties via ticketing- en workflowsystemen.
  • Voorbereiden, uitvoeren en evalueren van cyber awareness-initiatieven en phishingsimulaties.
  • Bijdragen aan documentatie, standaardisatie en de continue verbetering van processen, werkwijzen, governance en ondersteunende oplossingen.

📝 Jouw profiel

  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring als cybersecurity analist binnen vulnerability management, met focus op de identificatie en opvolging van kwetsbaarheden.
  • Je hebt ervaring als Security Consultant binnen minstens één van de volgende domeinen: data, infrastructuur of applicaties.
  • Je beschikt over aantoonbare expertise binnen een specifiek kennisdomein van information security, zoals information security managementprocessen, kwetsbaarheidsanalyses, pentesten, applicatiebeveiliging, privileged access management of encryptieoplossingen.
  • Je hebt ervaring met vulnerability scanning- en exposure managementoplossingen.
  • Je analyseert, optimaliseert en documenteert securityprocessen en governance op een gestructureerde manier.
  • Je hebt ervaring met securitybeheertechnieken en/of raamwerken zoals ISO 27000, COBIT for Security, NIST, OWASP en CIS Critical Security Controls.
  • Je kan technische bevindingen helder vertalen naar rapportering en aanbevelingen voor zowel technische als niet-technische stakeholders.
  • Je hebt ervaring met scripting en automatisering in Python en kan zelfstandig automatiseringsoplossingen opzetten en onderhouden.
  • Ervaring met ticketing- en workflowsystemen voor de opvolging van bevindingen en remediatieacties is vereist.
  • Relevante certificeringen binnen het expertisegebied, zoals CISM, CISSP of CEH, zijn een sterke meerwaarde.
  • Je hebt affiniteit met of ervaring in cyber awareness-programma's en phishingsimulaties.
  • Je werkt zelfstandig, legt snel verbanden en zet automatisering doelgericht in binnen een diverse technische omgeving met uiteenlopende technologieën, platformen, cloudomgevingen en architecturen.
  • Taalvereiste: Nederlandstalig op Europees CEFR-niveau C2.

💼 Aanbod

Je zal deel uitmaken van een groeiende KMO met ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je in een uitdagende maar aangename werkomgeving terecht komt met leuke collega's. Samen met jou stippelen we een carriereplan uit, met aandacht en budget voor bijkomende opleidingingen / certificaties. Je kan rekenen op een motiverend salaris, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen, inclusief bedrijfswagen (of alternatieve vergoeding).

jobs.excerpt: Notably is growing our team of people on a mission to make research a part of everyday work.
jobs.description:
Notably is growing our team of people on a mission to make research a part of everyday work. We help teams collect, analyze, and share qualitative research.

Notably is an inclusive and supportive team that trusts and respects each other. We bring our whole selves to work and celebrate what makes us unique. We’re an early-stage startup with a high bar for excellence & productivity, but we leave ego, competitiveness, and hustle culture at the door. We believe in creating a calm and inviting workplace culture so that we can all thrive and do our best work and still have plenty of time to refuel our energy.

Some projects you could work on:

  • The split-screen infinite canvas and table workspace in Notably where researchers analyze qualitative data.
  • Enhancing the canvas experience with new tools and collaboration.
  • Exploring new ways to visualize qualitative data with a quantitative lens that could help researchers make meaning out of the mess.
  • Combining machine learning and AI with research frameworks and best practices to create an experience that will super power our researchers.
  • Solving for performance and memory optimizations– we want to keep pushing the limits of what’s possible while maintaining high performance.
  • Improving core features like search, transcriptions, content management, and more.

We’d love to hear from you if you have:

  • At least 3 years of professional experience shipping features or products as a full-stack developer.
  • Demonstrated fluency with the following:
    • Typescript, React, GraphQL, and Node.
  • Experience with automated testing frameworks and TDD in Javascript.
  • Experience with the following is a plus:
    • Familiarity with Postgres, AWS.
    • Experience building real-time collaboration tools
    • Experience using HTML canvas
    • Background in AI, NLP, or data science.
  • Proactive and strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • A desire to work in a startup: high impact and experimental.
  • An interest in mentorship, learning from others, and digging into new challenges.
  • A collaborative vision of the product process. Every member of our team is involved from ideation to implementation.
  • A healthy skepticism and curiosity. Comfortable saying “I don’t know” and participating in research calls with users.

Our hiring process:

The end-to-end hiring process will take a couple of weeks and includes:

  • An initial call with our CPO and founder.
  • A virtual interview with your future teammates.
  • A paid take-home project (that could be completed in a day) and practical technical screen with our engineering team.

If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the points outlined in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Timezone requirements:

This is a fully remote position, however, candidates must either be based out of Europe (our technical lead is in Georgia) or in the Eastern timezone in US. Candidates who don't match this preference will not be considered for this role.

Pay & benefits:

  • Competitive salary & equity
  • Remote-first
  • Generous PTO
  • Learning & development stipend
  • Work from home stipend
  • Company on-sites

About Notably:

Notably was founded by Brittany Fuller and Allison Marshall in 2021 after both having experienced in their careers as aproduct manager and a product designer, a lack of solutions that aligned with the methodologies commonly used for research analysis and synthesis. They saw an opportunity to innovate in this space and solve a timeless problem: making sense out of conversational data. Today, Notably helps teams collect, analyze, and share qualitative research.

Salary: $75,000 – $100,000 / year

jobs.description:
Note from Diego, WiFi Tribe Founder:

I invited 7 internet strangers to spend a month living and working in my childhood home in Bolivia.

It was never meant to be a “business”. Just a group of friends traveling the world together.

It’s been 8 wild years…

Since that first trip, we’ve brought 2,500 nomads together in 80 cities to colive and cowork around the world, one month at a time.

Our work has sparked thousands of lifelong friendships, countless perspective-shifting conversations, hundreds of startup projects and career shifts, so many new romances, lots of weddings, a few babies, and an unimaginable amount of core memories.

What we do changes lives.

Not a little, but a lot and in every way you can think of.

If this excites you, keep reading to see if this might be the most perfect job ever created for you.

What is WiFi Tribe?

We believe that life wasn’t meant to be lived in just one place. That your best work can be done from anywhere. And, that everything is better when you have great people by your side.

We bring together great people from around the world to help them overcome the loneliness of solo travel, find true community wherever they go, and make their biggest travel dreams a reality, together.

We connect our members through:

40 coliving/coworking retreats in exciting destinations,

a Slack community where members share advice and support each other, and

an exclusive app that helps members meet in-person anywhere in the world, and plan their next big adventure together.

WiFi Tribe is THE vetted global community for remote professionals who seek growth and long-lasting travel connections.

YOUR Mission:

The Tribe needs a lot of tech and business operations to connect so many people around the world.

We’re looking for a Tech Lead & Business Ops to take charge of our technology stack and help us keep the day-to-day of the company operating smoothly.

You will be the centre-point for the tools that power our community. You’ll help scale our operations by enhancing our booking systems, integrating external services, and automating workflows. This role is perfect for a hands-on tech leader with a passion for building impactful systems and a knack for solving complex challenges.

Your work will directly shape the experience of thousands of members, empowering them to live, work, and explore the world together.

Who We Are (Our Culture)

  • We’re obsessed with this community. We have all chosen to join the team, first and foremost, because we love this community; a place where remarkable people from all over the world meet and shape their ideal lives together.
  • We’re a tight-knit team. We look out for one another, cheer each other on, and celebrate every win. We’re fully remote, and always bouncing around the world, but take every chance to meet up in person.
  • We’re as diverse as the United Nations. Our team of 13 represents 10 different nationalities! Many of us have become permanently nomadic global citizens, as we travel the world side-by-side with our members.
  • We’re small but mighty. Our small size is our strength. It helps us stay agile, creative, and united in the camaraderie of achieving our mission. We’re nifty, we’re inventive and we don’t give up.
  • We show courage. We don’t compromise when it comes to our values, our mission, or who we are. Every member of our team has the courage to stand up for what they believe in and challenge bad ideas. We know that doing the right thing always pays off in the end.
  • We care. We take full ownership of our work because we take pride in everything we do. We care about how we show up and who or what we’re becoming. And of course, we care about our teammates and our community members.
  • We’re explorers at heart. We’re curious and adaptable, which is why each of us chose to take on this crazy challenge of building a global community and a startup at the same time. Everyone on the team has lived, worked, and travelled with the Tribe for at least a month – some of us for years. Joining this team means embarking on the biggest adventure of your career.
  • We lead with humility. We don’t compete for titles or status; we’re driven by passion for our mission and love for our work. There is no space for big egos here. But, we take pride in our work and in becoming great at what we do.

Requirements

Who You Are (Traits)

We’re seeking a builder who is also a thinker—someone who thrives in a fast-paced, iterative environment and can bring a product-oriented mindset to the table.

  • You thrive under pressure and can juggle multiple priorities without breaking a sweat.
  • You’re a meticulous problem solver who never lets anything slip through the cracks. You analyse data and try to understand the root cause following the first-principle thinking methodology.
  • You’re strategic and organised and love creating systems that empower teams to do their best work.
  • You’re a self-starter who takes ownership of projects from start to finish and delivers results.
  • A collaborative mindset with excellent communication skills in a remote-first environment.
  • You embrace rapid iteration and short-release cycles for customer-facing and internal tools.
  • You are pragmatic and balance the trade-offs between building in-house tools and integrating external services.
  • You are passionate about the user experience and product-driven, and you understand and deliver intuitive, user-friendly designs.

What You’ve Done (Qualifications)

  • Experience with payment integrations and CRM platforms to streamline workflows and optimise business processes.
  • Experience integrating external APIs and services: Proven ability to connect and manage third-party tools to enhance functionality and performance.
  • 2+ years of server administration and management: Proficient in maintaining, troubleshooting, and optimising server environments.
  • 2+ years of experience with database management: Strong knowledge of relational databases, preferably PostgreSQL.
  • Hands-on experience running custom web applications: Demonstrated ability to manage and maintain live applications, ensuring stability and performance.

Ideal Skills/Background (But Not Required)

  • 2+ years of experience with Docker or Kubernetes: Familiarity with containerisation and orchestration concepts.
  • Experience with low code and automation tools: Familiarity with tools such as Zapier and experience in utilising such tools to build integrations or apps.
  • Understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript: General knowledge of web technologies to support collaboration with development teams.
  • Experience with web application development workflows: Preferably with exposure to Python, Django, and PostgreSQL environments.
  • Knowledge of SysOps/DevOps practices: Awareness of best practices for system operations and infrastructure automation.
  • Experience with data analysis and business intelligence reporting: Experience in data analysis and using tools such as Tableau, Metabase or advanced spreadsheet formulae.
  • Experience with remote work or digital nomad culture: Comfortable working in distributed teams and understanding the nuances of remote collaboration.

Things You Might Do Here (Responsibilities)

Technical Ownership

  • Take full ownership of WiFi Tribe’s tech stack, ensuring reliability, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Define and oversee the architecture and workflows for our booking platform—focused on design, not coding - ensuring seamless execution by the development team
  • Design, implement, and optimise integrations with third-party systems to enhance functionality.

Collaboration & Automation

  • Partner with operations, marketing, and other teams to identify areas for workflow automation and implement solutions.
  • Collaborate across departments to ensure technology aligns with business needs.

System Design & Problem-Solving

  • Plan and execute the development of a custom Property Management System (PMS) or evaluate and implement third-party solutions.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure or application issues, keeping the team productive and systems running smoothly.
  • Manage technical projects from concept to completion, ensuring clear communication and timely delivery.

Benefits

  • A Culture of Connection: Be part of a team and community prioritising meaningful relationships.
  • Freedom to Explore: Work remotely from anywhere in the world while helping others do the same.
  • A Mission That Matters: Build tools for a community that transforms lives and inspires growth.
  • $1,500 - $2,500 monthly for part-time work, depending on experience and track record of success in similar roles.
  • Take on a key role in a growing start-up with a community described by its members as transformative and “life-changing” that’s built a cult-like following and is now one of the strongest brands in a rapidly growing market.
  • Opportunities to join Chapters: If you're okay with making some spontaneous travel plans, you can join any Chapter that still has spots left for free! Experience the most adventurous months of your life. Travel and work remotely alongside a group of talented but down-to-earth remote professionals.
  • Be part of a tight-knit community of remote-working, entrepreneurial professionals and build a mighty global network.
  • Sponsored learning resources and conference opportunities.

jobs.description:
C++ Software Engineer

Remote (UK-based) | Full-Time

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (). Our network handles over $50 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 40+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The Role

We're looking for a C++ Software Engineer who wants to build low-latency trading infrastructure on Linux. You'll work on the core components of our Switchboard trading platform — pricing engines, connectivity gateways, market-data systems, and the messaging layer that ties them together.

This is not a role where you write code and throw it over a wall. You build it, you test it, you deploy it, you support it in production, and you improve it. Our engineers own the full lifecycle — from design through to operational excellence. When something breaks at 4pm on a Friday, you're part of the team that investigates and fixes it.

Occasional hours outside the normal working day are required for production releases, scheduled maintenance windows, and Level 3 support during critical incidents. We keep this to a minimum and recognise the commitment — but owning a production trading platform means being there when it matters.

What You'll Work On

  • Modern C++20 and Go on Linux — a modern software stack based on open source

  • Cloud-native infrastructure on AWS with colocation in key data centres

  • Microsecond-level latency optimisation and high-throughput messaging

  • Market-data and reference-data pipelines across multiple asset classes

  • FIX protocol integrations with global banks and liquidity providers

  • Observability and monitoring — dashboards, alerting, and metrics that make system behaviour visible

  • Production systems that handle real money — reliability is not optional

What We Need

Technical:

  • Strong C++ with Linux systems programming (3+ years)

  • Comfortable working close to the metal — you understand what's underneath your code

  • Experience with performance-sensitive systems (profiling, optimisation, deterministic behaviour)

  • Familiarity with networking fundamentals (TCP/UDP, socket programming)

  • Go experience is a strong bonus — we use Go extensively for microservices and command-line tooling, and you'll be expected to work with it internally. If you don't know it yet, strong C++ engineers pick it up quickly

  • Python for scripting, automation, testing, and data analysis — used across the platform for tooling and operational workflows

  • Git and shell scripting

  • Experience in financial services or trading technology is a plus but not essential

How you work:

  • You ship. You're delivery-focused — you iterate, you improve, you get things into production

  • You own it. When you build something, you take responsibility for its behaviour in production. You respond to incidents (15-minute acknowledgement SLA during working hours), investigate issues, and close the loop

  • You write things down. Documentation is not an afterthought — it's how we scale knowledge across a distributed team. If it's not written down, it doesn't exist

  • You communicate. We're a distributed team across multiple time zones. Clear, proactive communication — especially when things go wrong — is essential

  • You care about quality. You write clean, testable code. You review your peers' work thoughtfully. You push for continuous improvement without gold-plating

  • You embrace AI tooling. We use AI tools (Claude, Gemini) to amplify our engineering capability — from code review and debugging to incident investigation and documentation. You don't need to be an expert, but you should be curious and willing to learn

What You Get

  • Real problems —trading systems where performance is measured in microseconds, not user clicks

  • An excellent team — senior engineers who care about craft, collaborate openly, and hold each other to high standards

  • Ownership — small teams, clear accountability, direct impact on the platform and our clients

  • Competitive package — up to 30 days leave + bank holidays, private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites

  • Remote-friendly — work from home with flexibility. We trust our people to deliver

  • Sustainable pace — we work hard, but we don't burn people out. Balance is how we stay sharp

  • Growth — career progression to senior roles, performance specialisation, or technical leadership. We invest in people who invest in us

We believe in transparency, honest feedback, and writing things down. We celebrate delivery, not activity. We frame AI as empowering people — removing toil, amplifying capability, enabling higher-value work.

We aim to build systems that don't depend on the heroics of individuals to maintain and support — systems and processes that are resilient, documented, and sustainable.

Our Hiring Process

We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages.

Stage 1: Initial Conversation with Talent Acquisition

Format: Video call, ~30-45 minutes

Stage 2: Hiring Manager Conversation with the relevant team lead or hiring manager

Format: Video call, ~60 minutes

Stage 3: Technical Interview with two members of the relevant engineering team
Format: Video call, interactive session, ~60 minutes

What to expect in each stage will be explained by Talent Acquisition if you're invited to interview. Throughout the process, we aim to keep momentum with no unnecessary delays between stages, and feedback typically comes within a few business days.

*Please note that depending on availability, Stage 2 and 3 may swap around.

How to Apply

Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you'll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role.

Right to Work: Candidates must have the existing right to work in the UK. We are not currently able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Equal Opportunities: Reactive Markets is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

Reasonable Adjustments: If you need any adjustments or support during the application or interview process, please let us know — we're happy to accommodate.

Data Protection: By applying, you consent to Reactive Markets processing your personal data for recruitment purposes, in line with our privacy policy.

jobs.excerpt: About AtlysOur mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
jobs.description:
About Atlys

Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.

Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.

Atlys is changing that.

We’re building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for 1M+ travellers across 127 countries. But we’re still early.

The Role

We're looking for a City Scout to help build the most reliable database of work-friendly cafes for travellers.

You'll visit cafes across your assigned city, verify information like WiFi quality, internet speed, plug points and overall work-friendliness, and submit accurate data that powers a new Atlys product. Every visit directly improves the travel experience for thousands of users.

The Job

  • Explore and discover great cafes: Visit assigned cafes across your city, experience them as a customer, and identify places that travellers would genuinely enjoy working from.

  • Collect high-quality on-ground data: Verify key details including WiFi availability, internet speed, passwords, plug points, seating, ambience and overall work-friendliness to ensure the information is accurate and reliable.

  • Contribute to a travel product used by thousands: Capture your observations by completing a short digital survey after every visit, helping build one of the world's most reliable databases of work-friendly cafes.

  • Cover your city efficiently: Plan your visits across assigned neighbourhood clusters to maximize coverage while maintaining consistency and quality.

  • Maintain exceptional data quality: Pay close attention to detail, validate every submission, and ensure the information travellers see on the Atlys app can be trusted.

The Ideal Candidate

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Are a college student or have a flexible part-time schedule.

  • Enjoy exploring your city and discovering new places.

  • Have strong attention to detail and collect information accurately.

  • Are comfortable travelling independently within your city.

  • Own a smartphone and are reliable, proactive and self-driven.

We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.

What you can expect

Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.

Here’s what you can expect:

  • Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.

  • Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us.

  • A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.

  • Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.

  • Learning & development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.

  • Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.

  • Great tools to do your best work, including high-spec equipment and software.

  • An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.

Come build the intelligence layer for global travel

jobs.description:
Twoim wsparciem i skarbnicą wiedzy merytorycznej będzie sam Szaman Marketingu, który zgłębi Twoją wiedzę w:

  • Online marketingu (z naciskiem na email marketing i samodzielne prowadzenie sklepów internetowych)
  • Prowadzeniu i działaniach operacyjnych ecommerce “od kuchni”
  • Wdrażania lejków sprzedażowych czyli co po kolei zrobić aby biznes się spinał

Trafisz również pod skrzydła Szamanki Anki, która wesprze Cię i będzie Twoim osobistym mentorem z tematów takich jak:

  • Skuteczne zarządzanie projektami
  • Usprawnianie wewnętrznych procesów i systemów
  • Zarządzanie zespołem i współpracą z podwykonawcami
  • Rozliczanie i raportowanie pracy działów sprzedaży i marketingu

Z nami zdobędziesz wiedzę w zakresie:

  • Zarządzania biznesem online
  • Efektywności w biznesie
  • Zarządzania sobą i projektami w czasie
  • Administracji
  • Automatyzacji działań operacyjnych
  • Lejków sprzedażowych
  • Email marketingu
  • Przeprowadzania złożonych kampanii marketingowych

Poniżej znajdziesz opis obowiązków i wyzwań, które czekają na Ciebie na tym stanowisku. Wyszkolimy Cię z tych tematów:

  • Obsługa narzędzia do email marketingu
  • Weryfikacja i kontrola jakości landing pagey, mailingów, komunikatów sprzedażowych i płatnych kampanii reklamowych
  • Obsługa maila firmowego
  • Generowanie i zbieranie faktur
  • Generowanie i opracowywanie raportów dokumentujących wyniki całego zespołu
  • Umawianie spotkań z kluczowymi członkami zespołu i partnerami zewnętrznymi
  • Zbieranie informacji, research
  • Opracowywanie szablonów raportów w Excelu w celu usprawnienia pracy całego zespołu
  • Zarządzanie i czynny udział w procesie obsługi klienta

Czego oczekujemy?

  • Zapału i chęci ciągłego samorozwoju w wyżej wymienionych obszarach
  • Proaktywności i nastawienia na maksymalne uproszczenie sposobu w jaki pracujemy przy zachowaniu wysokiej jakości
  • Doświadczenie w zarządzaniu kilkoma projektami/priorytetami w czasie (mniejsze lub większe)
  • Wiedza o lejkach sprzedażowych i marketingu online przynajmniej na poziomie średniozaawansowanym (nie musisz być ekspertem, ale ważne byś miał już jakieś zaplecze)
  • Znajomość Excela
  • Konsekwencji i determinacji w osiąganiu celów i realizacji powierzonych zadań

3 miesięczny bezpłatny staż szkoleniowy (20-25h w tygodniu) by sprawdzić czy nadajecie z Szamanem na tych samych falach i przygotować Cię do zostania samodzielnym ogarniaczem e-commerce'ów.

Po stażu, jeśli nasza współpraca będzie przebiegać pomyślnie i obydwie strony będą zadowolone, chętnie podejmiemy płatną współpracę.

Godziny: Raczej jesteśmy elastyczni. Pracujemy w 100% zdalnie.

Czujesz, że to coś dla Ciebie? Aplikuj już teraz, by nikt inny Cię nie ubiegł i rozwijaj się z nami.

Zamiast CV, nagraj i podeślij nam krótkie video, w którym opowiesz nam o sobie i dlaczego uważasz, że jesteś odpowiednią osobą na to stanowisko oraz załącz wynik testu MBTI, który wypełnisz pod tym linkiem:

Nie przyjmujemy zgłoszeń od kandydatów, którzy wysyłają CV!

HOWGH!

W naszym tipii robi się coraz większy chaos a to najwyższa pora by przyjąć do wioski nowego indianina.

Stajemy przed misją znalezienia prawej ręki Szamana Marketingu, czyli jednej z absolutnie kluczowych osób w naszej wiosce.

W skrócie: nasz Szaman szuka swojej prawej ręki, która pomoże mu ogarnąć codzienny chaos (2 ecommercy i agencję marketingową), ustalić priorytety i co najważniejsze - pilnować by wszystkie nasze działania szły zgodnie z harmonogramem i wyznaczonymi datami. Dodatkowo Prawa Ręka Szamana będzie również znała przynajmniej podstawy email marketingu, obsługi narzędzi do automatyzacji mailingu oraz budowania i wdrażania skutecznych lejków marketingowych, a postawienie szybkiego landing page’a nie będzie dla niej wyzwaniem. Spokojnie - jeśli nie ogarniasz jeszcze wszystkich z tych rzeczy (albo nawet i większości), to Cię tego nauczymy. Ważne byś miał jednak jakieś podstawy i by interesowały Cię tematy skutecznego zarządzania oraz marketingu.

Jeśli w przyszłości chcesz otworzyć swój własny biznes albo zostać liderem zespołu to teraz masz najlepszą szansę na to aby zdobyć umiejętności, koniecznie w obydwu przypadkach. Pod czułym okiem Szamana Marketingu i Szamanki Anki nauczysz się jak wdrażać ulepszenia w sklepach internetowych i rozwijać nowe e-commercy aby jak najszybciej zaczęły generować dochody.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Support Engineer (SIP / VoIP / FoIP)
jobs.excerpt: T38Fax is seeking an experienced Technical Support Engineer with a wealth of experience troubleshooting SIP / VoIP / FoIP issues in a customer-facing role.
jobs.description:
T38Fax is seeking an experienced Technical Support Engineer with a wealth of experience troubleshooting SIP / VoIP / FoIP issues in a customer-facing role. We're excited to be scaling our customer support team to keep up with the rapid growth of our popular T.38 Fax Over IP (FoIP) service. In this senior-level role we expected you to be well-versed in fundamental network concepts, with a demonstrated history of troubleshooting customer SIP and VoIP calls. The ideal candidate will also have experience diagnosing facsimile transmissions over SIP, especially if that experience involved T.38 Fax Over IP sessions.

First, a Word About Fax

Fans of John Oliver’s “How Is This Still A Thing” segments might be amused to learn that fax remains deeply entrenched in the way many companies transact their daily business. Indeed, it seems fax is still very much a thing! In its annual report on the fax industry, Business Research Insights reports that the global fax market size was 2.36 billion in 2023 and is projected to reach 4.25 billion by 2032 at a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of almost 7%. It’s especially surprising, then, that most modern VoIP/SIP and cloud-based phone companies neither support fax over SIP nor understand how they might do so (until we show them how easy it is). Our fax-approved SIP trunks are ready to go today and fill a vital need in a growing and underserved industry that shows no signs of slowing down for many years to come.

About You

As a Technical Support Engineer you will be responsible for diagnosing and resolving customer issues related to SIP trunking, T.38 fax transmissions, call quality, and network configurations. You will work closely with customers, internal teams, and vendors to ensure seamless communication experiences. You are a proud, card-carrying tech-geek with a superhero’s penchant for helping others. You breathe all things engineering, innovation, and data. Logic is your friend, and you use it generously. Equipped with an entrepreneurial attitude, you are relentlessly energetic and excited by new challenges. If you aren’t multi-tasking, it means you are under-challenged. You don’t just capture packets, you use science (not superstition) to tame them.

Your Mission

This is absolutely not an IT help-desk role. We call our support team 'engineers' because of the highly technical nature of troubleshooting SIP and T.38 at industrial scale. You will:

  • Provide Escalated (Tier 3) support for FoIP and SIP-related technical issues via email, phone and case management system (Zendesk).
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot SIP signaling, call setup failures, one-way audio, jitter, latency, and packet loss.
  • Analyze SIP traces, PCAP captures, and logs using tools like Wireshark and tcpdump.
  • Support T.38 Fax Over IP (FoIP) implementations, troubleshooting failed fax transmissions and improving reliability.
  • Work with PBX systems (Asterisk, FreePBX, 3CX, etc.), VoIP gateways, and SBCs.
  • Assist customers with network configurations, NAT traversal and firewall rules.
  • Escalate complex issues to engineering teams and collaborate with vendors as needed.
  • Take ownership of reported customer issues and see problems through to resolution, ensuring proper recording and closure of all issues.
  • Write documentation, knowledge base articles and FAQs, and document troubleshooting steps, best practices and solutions in the company's knowledge base for use by both internal staff and customers.
  • Test interoperability of new VoIP/FoIP equipment and create user guides for various IP-PBX and SIP-compatible devices for use with our SIP Trunking service.

Qualifications

Expert-level support is a core component of our brand and is deeply ingrained in our culture. We look for a mix of the technical expertise, troubleshooting skills, and industry knowledge that will be needed to solve complex problems, including:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field, or combination of education and experience may be considered.
  • Solid understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, NAT, VPNs and firewall rules) and networking protocols, in particular VoIP/SIP.
  • Experience with fax and/or FoIP a plus.
  • Experience with Wireshark.
  • Experience with Asterisk, Kamailio, FreeSWITCH, OpenSIPS, or cloud-based VoIP APIs (Twilio, Plivo, Telnyx, etc.).
  • Working knowledge of Linux/Unix Operating System.
  • Careful, methodical approach to troubleshooting complex technical issues.
  • Experience with help desk ticketing systems (Zendesk, Jira, ServiceNow, etc.).
  • Excellent written and verbal communications including the ability to explain complex technical concepts to customers.
  • Excellent customer-facing skills.

Your Style

  • Customer satisfaction is your goal, and you pursue it relentlessly
  • You have an unquenchable desire to learn
  • You communicate clearly and concisely with technical and non-technical audiences
  • You are a multitasker with the ability to properly prioritize
  • You happily follow established procedures, but know when to propose improvements

Our Offer

  • Competitive salary with annual profit-sharing bonus
  • Casual, informal work environment
  • Flexible working arrangements (remote/hybrid options)
  • Generous PTO allowance
  • Healthcare
  • 401(k)
  • Flyers tickets with VIP parking
  • A team of aces
  • An open mind for new ideas and methodologies

Work Location & Compensation

This role can be performed remotely, hybrid, or in-office at our headquarters in Conshohocken, just outside of Center City Philadelphia. Candidates who choose to work in-office may be eligible for higher compensation, additional in-office perks, and increased collaboration opportunities. Compensation for remote employees is adjusted based on market rates for their location.

Our Story

Founded in 2016 and based in Conshohocken just outside of Philadelphia, PA, T38Fax provides fax-optimized SIP trunks to business customers within the US and Canada. We’re similar to a Voice Over IP (VoIP) phone company, except our network is optimized for fax transmissions instead of voice. Our product is unique and in high demand, we’re one of just a handful of companies that do this worldwide, and we have an exceptional reputation in the industry. In 2020, T38Fax was recognized by Inc. Magazine as one of the fastest growing companies in the US and by the Entrepreneurs Forum of Greater Philadelphia (EFGP) as one of the 100 fastest growing companies in the Philly metro area.

We remain small and agile, which makes this a fun, dynamic, and challenging place to work. The work environment is casual and, for the most part, informal. Expectations are high and excellence is encouraged and rewarded. We strive to make sure that we have a team-oriented group that can also work well independently. If you enjoy working in a high freedom, high demand environment with a small but talented group of people this may just be the job for you.

We offer a competitive benefits package including healthcare, a substantial number of paid days off (PTO), a generous profit-sharing plan, and access to our Flyers season tickets for yourself and a guest. We're a great group of people doing exceptional things for our customers and having fun doing it. Like any emerging growth company, this will be hard work, but more importantly, it will be fun and immensely rewarding. We think you already know if this is a position for you, and if so, we look forward to reviewing your application!

Are you The One? If so, please send your battle plan and a certificate of your superpowers. Alternatively, a cover letter and resume will suffice. At least for now.

We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. You set the direction, stay close to engineering on reliability, and work closely with the Product Managers in those areas so they can build on one Energy Management System.
