jobs.description:
Hörer in die Hand, wählen, pitchen, Termin. Nochmal. Und nochmal. Und am Ende des Tages weißt du genau, was du geleistet hast – weil deine Ergebnisse messbar sind. Wenn sich das für dich nicht nach Arbeit, sondern nach Antrieb anhört, dann lies weiter.

Wir suchen keinen, der Kaltakquise „auch mal machen kann". Wir suchen jemanden, der sie liebt. Der den Kick spürt, wenn ein Entscheider nach 30 Sekunden zuhört statt aufzulegen. Der Einwände nicht als Problem sieht, sondern als Spielfeld.

Bei Clementine Media helfen wir Kommunen in ganz Deutschland, ihre offenen Stellen zu besetzen – mithilfe von Neuro-Recruiting, das wirklich funktioniert.

Über 150 Städte und Gemeinden vertrauen uns bereits. Dein Job: Bürgermeister, Hauptamtsleiter und Personalchefs ans Telefon bekommen und qualifizierte Termine für unser Vertriebsteam setzen.

Du öffnest die Tür – wir machen den Rest.

Aufgaben

  • Du kontaktierst proaktiv Städte, Gemeinden und Landkreise per Telefon und identifizierst den richtigen Ansprechpartner (Bürgermeister, Geschäftsführer, Hauptamtsleiter, Personalverantwortliche).
  • Du führst professionelle Erstgespräche am Telefon, weckst Interesse an unserer Recruiting-Lösung und positionierst Clementine Media als kompetenten Partner.
  • Du vereinbarst qualifizierte Termine – das ist dein zentrales Ziel und deine wichtigste Kennzahl.
  • Du pflegst deine Kontakte und Gesprächsergebnisse sauber in unserem CRM-System (Close CRM) und hältst deine Pipeline aktuell.
  • Du arbeitest mit einem erprobten Gesprächsleitfaden, den du mit der Zeit zu deinem eigenen machst und kontinuierlich verbesserst.
  • Du wirkst aktiv bei der Optimierung unser Vertriebsprozesse mit.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast Erfahrung in der telefonischen Kaltakquise, im Telefonvertrieb oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle (z. B. SDR, BDR, Call Agent, Terminierung) – idealerweise im B2B-Umfeld.
  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau – am Telefon klingst du professionell, sympathisch und überzeugend.
  • Du hast keine Scheu vor dem Hörer und lässt dich von einem „Nein" nicht aus der Ruhe bringen. Hartnäckigkeit mit Fingerspitzengefühl ist deine Stärke.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, organisierst dich selbstständig und behältst auch bei hohem Anrufvolumen den Überblick.
  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen und digitalen Tools.
  • Erfahrung im öffentlichen Sektor oder Kommunalvertrieb ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss – wir bringen dir alles Nötige bei.

Benefits

  • 100 % Remote – arbeite von dort, wo du am produktivsten bist (innerhalb Deutschlands).
  • Erprobtes System – du bekommst einen bewährten Gesprächsleitfaden, Schulungen und ein CRM, das für dich arbeitet.
  • Sinnvolle Arbeit – du hilfst Kommunen, die Menschen zu finden, die den öffentlichen Dienst am Laufen halten: Erzieher, Ingenieure, Verwaltungskräfte.
  • Wachsendes Unternehmen – über 130 Kommunen vertrauen uns bereits. Sei Teil unseres nächsten Wachstumsschritts.
  • Attraktive Vergütung ohne Deckel – solides Fixgehalt plus unbegrenzte Provisionen. Je mehr qualifizierte Termine du setzt, desto mehr verdienst du – ohne Obergrenze.
  • Kurze Wege, flache Hierarchien – du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen und hast echten Einfluss.

Du brauchst kein langes Anschreiben. Bewirb dich einfach – wir melden uns schnell. Wenn du der Typ bist, der lieber anruft als E-Mails zu schreiben, dann zeig uns genau das. Wir freuen uns, von dir zu hören.

Portfolio decisions at scale are a hard data problem. Our customers manage thousands of initiatives across hundreds of teams, and they need a platform that can make sense of all of it - fast, reliably, and intelligently. That's the core of what this role is about.

You'll work on the systems that power Dragonboat's platform - from the ontology that represents a portfolio to the integrations that keep it in sync with the tools our customers already use. You'll also be building the backend foundations that make AI-powered features possible and production-grade.

This is a role for someone who takes deep pride in backend craft, wants real ownership over systems that matter, and moves with urgency.

Responsibilities

  • Own and evolve the core platform - the data model, APIs, and services that everything else is built on
  • Design and build the backend systems that power our portfolio intelligence layer, including data aggregation, scoring, and analysis at scale
  • Build and maintain integrations with the tools our customers use daily
  • Make architectural decisions that will hold up as we grow
  • Collaborate directly with product and other engineers to go from problem to solution fast
  • Use agentic coding tools as a first-class part of how you work - not occasionally, but as your default mode

You may be a good fit if you:

  • Have 4+ years of backend engineering experience and strong opinions about how to build systems that last
  • Are the kind of engineer who owns a problem fully - from the first design conversation to production
  • Move fast without cutting corners, and know the difference
  • Have worked on data-heavy systems and enjoy the craft of getting them right - modeling, querying, optimizing
  • Are already using AI tools heavily in your workflow and have developed a real point of view on how to get the most out of them
  • Communicate clearly, give honest feedback, and don't need much hand-holding

Strong candidates may also:

  • Have experience building or scaling integrations with third-party platforms
  • Have worked on multi-tenant SaaS at scale
  • Have built features that surface data-driven insights to end users - not just storing and serving data, but making it meaningful

How we're different

Most engineering teams at this stage have already added layers of process that slow things down. We haven't. At Dragonboat, senior engineers work directly on problems that matter, make real architectural calls, and see the results in production quickly. We're also at a moment where AI is reshaping both how we build and what our product can do - and we want engineers who want to be at the center of that.

Come work with us

We have a growing engineering team in the US and Portugal. We offer competitive compensation, flexible working hours, and an environment where good engineers can do their best work.

Our Dragonboat AI OS and apps help product and portfolio leaders — and their teams — make smarter decisions, automate manual work, and act on the right data together, driving outcomes across the entire product operating model.

Dragonboat is a venture-backed, fast-growing SaaS startup with remote teams in Portugal and the US.

Remote – California

This role serves as a technical authority and trusted advisor, working closely with executive stakeholders, sales teams, and engineering resources to define security strategy, architect solutions, and guide long-term modernization initiatives.

Lead Cybersecurity Architecture & Strategy

  • Establish reusable architectures and security standards across client environments
  • Guide long-term security roadmaps aligned with business and compliance objectives

  • Microsoft security ecosystem deployments (Microsoft Entra ID, Defender, Sentinel)
  • Endpoint security and XDR deployments (CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender, others)
  • SIEM/SOC architecture and optimization (Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, QRadar)
  • Network security modernization (firewalls, segmentation, secure access)
  • Identity transformation (SSO, MFA, conditional access)
  • Compliance-driven security frameworks (NIST, CIS, ISO 27001)

Identity, Cloud & Data Security Architecture

  • Design identity-first security using Microsoft Entra ID (SSO, MFA, Conditional Access)
  • Architect secure Azure-based environments with integrated security controls
  • Define governance, access policies, and identity lifecycle management
  • Secure workloads, applications, and data across hybrid environments

Security Oversight & Threat Strategy

  • Guide SIEM strategy, detection engineering, and advanced threat analysis
  • Architect and optimize SIEM and XDR platforms including Sentinel and CrowdStrike
  • Oversee vulnerability management and remediation strategies

Network & Infrastructure Security Design

  • Architect and validate solutions across Cisco, Palo Alto, Fortinet, and similar platforms
  • Design segmentation, secure access, and perimeter defense strategies
  • Integrate network security with identity and cloud controls

Compliance, Risk & Governance

  • Lead alignment with frameworks such as NIST, CIS, ISO 27001, GDPR
  • Conduct risk assessments and define mitigation strategies
  • Support audit readiness and compliance initiatives
  • Advise on governance and security policy development

Collaboration & Practice Development

  • Support cross-functional collaboration across sales, engineering, and leadership

jobs.title: Business Analyst (2026)
jobs.excerpt: If you have a curious sort of disposition, are great at explaining things, and can demonstrate the ability to help customers learn how to apply our cloud based software applications, then keep reading!
jobs.description:
If you have a curious sort of disposition, are great at explaining things, and can demonstrate the ability to help customers learn how to apply our cloud based software applications, then keep reading!
Grant Street Group continues to anticipate the growth of its SaaS model to our public sector clients. Whether it is tax processing or electronic payments, we have tools to make government work better.

We are looking for talented folks who:

—Want to know why things work the way they do.
—Excel at explaining things with the right amount of detail.
—Are capable communicators with the spoken and written word.
—Know how to collaborate within a team environment.
—Are dedicated learners with the ability to use software.
Our business analysts come from all sorts of academic, business or technical backgrounds. Their common threads? Strong academic performance, great writers, and the ability to engage others in meaningful, fun, and entertaining conversations. If this sounds like you then we do want to start talking about your future and ours!
There is some travel required to meet face-to-face with clients and colleagues: applicants should be comfortable with approximately 10-15% travel.
We reward teamwork, professional excellence, and individual responsibility. Using the best collaboration tools available, we offer a technology-rich work environment that makes it possible for us to support on-site and telecommuting positions tailored to the needs of our employees. If you are passionate about your work, you have entrepreneurial spirit and you want to be on a team of exceptional professionals, then this could be the opportunity you are looking for.
If you read our job posting and thought, “That sounds great, but what is this job actually like?”, then keep reading! The core function of our role at Grant Street Group is to be a liaison between our developers and our clients, and this requires us to wear many different hats.

So what do all of these “hats” really mean?

  • Problem Solving: Every day you work to solve complex problems. When you analyze a calculation, investigate the cause of a bug, or propose a new process you are venturing into unfamiliar territory to find a solution. Our clients and developers rely on your problem solving skills to ensure our software is built and supported effectively.
  • Client support: When a customer has a question, problem, or suggestion, they come to you! You are known as a subject matter expert and our clients rely on that expertise regularly. Whether the issue is major or minor, you know that Grant Street Group takes Software as a Service literally.
  • Prioritization: Our software is ever-changing. With that comes the need to prioritize what, when, and how changes are made. Since you’re working with the software and our clients daily, who better to prioritize than you? Business analysts are constantly asking themselves: Does this feature need to be completed before a certain time? What is the impact of this bug? How can other clients benefit from this change? We use a ticketing system to track pieces of work such as functionality requests and bug fixes. We then prioritize them for developers to work on.
  • Technical Specifications: It’s your job to convey to the developers what changes need to be made. What happens when you click this button? What does the page look like? How is this file transferred to an external system? In this way, you are directly affecting the product and our clients’ experience.
  • Testing: When a developer completes a change, you get to test it out (in a beta environment) to ensure that it’s working correctly. Does the new behavior match the specification? Does everything else surrounding the change still work correctly?
  • Implementations: We’re a growing company and adding new clients is an exciting part of that growth! Since you’re a subject matter expert, you coordinate with new clients to configure the software to best fit their needs. Think of yourself as a consultant. What business processes does the client need to accomplish? How can our software fit in with and help that process?
  • Training: Helping clients learn about how our software works is also part of your role. Whether it’s a new client coming up to speed on how tasks are completed, or an existing client that is incorporating a new feature into their process, you’re a resource for providing the information and tools they need.
Does this sound exciting and overwhelming at the same time? Most of us thought so too. If you haven’t had experience in this area before, know that many of us lacked business analyst experience before we came to Grant Street Group. What we did have was intellectual curiosity and a passion for problem solving. If you’ve already had business analyst experience, that’s great, and we’re excited about the possibility of you continuing on that path with us.
So now that you know what we do, why are you a great fit? You’ve probably spent a large majority of your life asking “Why” and then making sure that you figure out the answer. You love using all parts of your brain equally, and the thought of speaking with a client or learning about a database schema equally intrigues you. You’re the one that people rely on in team projects. You’re always itching to know more and you hold yourself and others to a high standard.
Before you begin the interview process, keep in mind that we have a tendency to pay special attention to those that put in extra effort in their applications. We are radical proponents of the belief that you are more than just a resume. If you’re excited about this opportunity, we can’t wait to get to know you!
Expected Salary Range: $70,000 – $120,000/year
Recruitment Fraud Warning:
It has come to our attention that various individuals have been posing as Grant Street Group employees and contacting job seekers to schedule interviews and/or complete pre-interview screening questions.

All legitimate Grant Street Group positions require completing an application on our website before an interview. When you are contacted by Grant Street Group, all correspondence will come from an email address ending in “@”.

The hiring process usually takes several weeks and begins with a phone or video interview. Grant Street Group will not ask you to use any platform other than Google Meet or Zoom to conduct an interview. We will not ask you to make payments or to provide your date of birth, social security number, or banking details during the interview process.

If you believe you have been a victim of recruiting fraud concerning Grant Street Group, please contact us at .

About Us

ElitevoraSys is a modern engineering consultancy focused on building high-performance operational platforms, automation pipelines, and data-driven workflows for clients who need real results - not just software.

We partner with organizations to design and deliver systems that streamline dispatch, asset management, field operations, and enterprise integrations.

Job Description

This is a remote position.

Team: Engineering – Platform Consulting

About ElitevoraSys

ElitevoraSys is a modern engineering consultancy focused on building high-performance operational platforms, automation pipelines, and data-driven workflows for clients who need real results - not just software. We partner with organizations to design and deliver systems that streamline dispatch, asset management, field operations, and enterprise integrations. Our work blends clean architecture, practical engineering, and a startup mindset.

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to help expand WorkPro, our flagship operations platform deployed across multiple client environments. You'll work in a small, senior team, own services end-to-end across the stack, and help shape the technical direction of a system used daily by real operational teams.

This role is perfect for an experienced full-stack engineer who enjoys solving complex workflow problems, building reliable APIs, and working across modern and legacy systems.

What You'll Do

Backend & Integrations

  • Build and maintain REST APIs using Java (Spring Boot), Python (Django/FastAPI), .NET (C#/), Golang, or comparable frameworks, powering dispatch, service orders, billing, and asset workflows.

  • Design relational schemas, migrations, and high-performance queries against SQL Server and PostgreSQL.

  • Develop integrations with enterprise platforms (Dynamics 365, Coupa, Trackunit, Power Automate/Logic Apps).

  • Maintain and modernize legacy backend code (Java/J2EE and similar stacks) while delivering new services in whichever language best fits the module.

  • Document APIs using OpenAPI/Swagger and maintain versioned contracts for client teams.

  • Implement workflow automation, asynchronous job processing, audit trails, reporting, and intelligent backend features — including AI-assisted or LLM-backed capabilities where they add value.

  • Ensure API performance, reliability, and security across high-volume operational workloads.

Frontend

  • Contribute to Angular UI components for WorkPro modules as needed.

  • Support role-based UI flows for dispatchers, managers, and field technicians.

  • Help maintain responsive, mobile-friendly interfaces across devices.

Team & Delivery

  • Work with a Product Owner to deliver features in tight, iterative cycles.

  • Collaborate with a Principal Developer on architecture and engineering standards.

  • Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and production deployments.

  • Own backend features from design through release.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional development experience (backend/API focus).

  • Strong hands-on experience shipping production REST APIs in at least one of: Java (Spring Boot), Python, .NET (C#), or Golang.

  • Solid SQL experience — relational modeling, complex queries, indexing, stored procedures.

  • Practical experience with an ORM (JPA/Hibernate, Entity Framework, SQLAlchemy, GORM, or equivalent) and migration tooling (Flyway, Liquibase, Alembic, or similar).

  • Experience maintaining and refactoring legacy codebases.

  • Experience integrating with enterprise systems (ERP/CRM).

  • Comfort with concurrency, messaging, and asynchronous processing (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar).

  • Testing discipline (JUnit/Mockito, pytest, xUnit/NUnit, Testcontainers, or equivalent depending on stack).

  • Basic working knowledge of Angular + TypeScript for occasional frontend contributions.

  • Good proficiency with AI-assisted development tools and workflows (e.g., Copilot, Claude, LLM-backed automation) is a strong plus.

  • Comfortable working in a collaborative, agile consulting environment.

Preferred

  • Experience with Dynamics 365, Power Automate, or Logic Apps.

  • SQL performance tuning and query optimization.

  • Experience with Azure (App Service, Functions, Service Bus), Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and DevOps practices.

  • Build and quality tooling: Maven/Gradle, pip/poetry, NuGet, Go modules, SonarQube, static analysis.

  • Deeper experience with AI-assisted development or LLM-backed workflows (prompt engineering, RAG, agentic tooling).

  • Background in operational, dispatch, or field-service software.

  • Polyglot experience across two or more of Java, Python, .NET, and Golang.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave

  • FSA/HSA options

  • BYOD reimbursement

Ce vei face in calitate de Content Writer in echipa DWF?

Așadar, fără să ne mai lungim, iată atribuțiile principale ale unui Content Writer la Digital Workforce:

  • Comunici cu membrii celorlalte departamente
  • Comunici cu clienții și managerii care le gestionează conturile pentru a te alinia cu cerințele și așteptările acestora.
  • Te familiarizezi cu nișa clientului
  • Identifici publicul țintă al articolului pe care urmează să-l scrii, intenția și așteptările cititorilor. Totodată, cauți și cele mai bune surse de informații.
  • Redactezi cel mai bun articol pe tema identificată de Content Arhitecții noștri ținând cont de:

- Limbajul potrivit pentru nișa dată. Tonul fiecărui articol este dat atât de cerințele clientului, cât și de platforma pe care urmează a fi publicate.
- Brandul clientului (știm că acest pas poate suna înfricoșător, dar noi avem deja rețeta completă pentru un brand content puternic).
- Experiența utilizatorului (UE) care cere o structură ușor de parcurs și lipsa absolută a oricăror greșeli de redactare.
- Feedbackul colegilor și al clientului care ne ajută să devenim mai buni cu fiecare articol redactat.

Cum devii Content Writer in echipa DWF?

  • Absolvent studii superioare in Litere, Filologie, Limbi și Literaturi Străine
  • Experiență de minim 2 ani pe o poziție similară de Copywriter Publicitate
  • Experiență în redactare articole din diferite domenii
  • Cunoștințe medii Wordpress, abilitati editare online
  • (Opțional) Cunoașterea fundamentelor SEO și a principiilor de marketing digital.

Iată cateva din motivele pentru care trebuie sa te alaturi DWF:

  1. Pachet Salarial atractiv (pachetul salarial conține salariul net și un sistem de bonusare bazat pe performanță).
  2. Zile libere suplimentare (fiecare an petrecut alături de DWF îți aduce o zi în plus de concediu. Contractul pornește de la 21 de zile pe an).
  3. Asigurare medicală (ai acces la serviciile celor mai bune clinici private datorită asigurării medicale private).
  4. Work from Home (până când ne vom putea întâlni în siguranță la birou, toată activitatea se desfășoară în regim de telemuncă).
  5. DWF Talks (sesiuni periodice de discuții libere în cadrul echipei, sau cu un invitat extern, din alt domeniu sau altă agenție de marketing).
  6. Acces la evenimente (DWF este partener în toate evenimentele relevante de E-commerce din România).
  7. DWF Party (știm să ne bucurăm de reușite, motiv pentru care organizăm, în medie, patru petreceri pe an, dintre care cel puțin una este… în afara orașului).
  8. DWF Exchange (programul DWF de schimb de experiență, cu agenții SEO - și nu numai - din Europa).
  9. Abonament la Bookster
  10. Oportunitatea de a lucra la cea mai mare agenție SEO din România (cu peste 650 de campanii SEO derulate de-a lungul a 7 ani în care ne-am menținut pe pozițiile de top pe piața din România, poți avea încredere că DWF nu oferă doar un loc de muncă, ci o experiență în perfecționarea abilităților tale de redactare a unui articol SEO demn de prima poziție în Google).

We are looking to expand our software engineers, seeking those with deep rooted entrepreneurial spirit.

Our serverless platform is a multi-tenant monorepo — Next.js and React on the front, tRPC and Prisma behind it, deployed on SST, TypeScript throughout. One engineer can follow a change from a form field to the database without crossing a team boundary. That's the point.

Engineering at Bask Health is AI-first and builder-led. Work starts with general understanding of problem, moves to tools like Claude and Cursor for further investigation, making a plan and building, tested on staging with realistic data, released to production, tested with real patient and care teams, and then back for systems and polish. AI is a default part of how we work, not a side experiment — because moving fast in healthcare requires every advantage.

We are looking for engineers who take end-to-end ownership, treat AI as a real collaborator, and care deeply about building software that meaningfully improves how healthcare is delivered.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and ship high-quality product experiences. Own key surfaces end to end, from concept through production. Write elegant, well-tested code — we have a real test suite and we intend to keep it that way.
  • Work across the stack. Follow a feature from the interface through the API to the database. No handoffs, no waiting on another team.
  • Work AI-first with Cursor and Claude Code. Use LLMs as your starting point. Draft intent, explore implementations, scaffold components, and refactor with AI in the loop. Apply your own judgment to meet the quality bar healthcare demands.
  • Prototype fast and validate with real users. Build and test quickly with real patients and care teams. Use what you learn to refine before fully committing — especially in sensitive clinical contexts where getting it right matters.
  • Build for scale and own the codebase. Translate product needs into reusable, well-architected patterns that make the next feature faster to ship.
  • Make automation legible and trustworthy. Build systems that clearly communicate what AI and automation are doing on behalf of patients and providers. Earn trust through transparency, reliability, and thoughtful defaults.
  • Champion performance, accessibility, and reliability. Ship work that is fast, robust, and accessible. Partner across the team to debug, optimize, and raise the bar over time.
  • Share AI-native workflows. Document prompts, patterns, and workflows that work, so we move faster together without cutting corners that matter to patient outcomes.

We are a highly collaborative team.

The ideal candidate is a full-stack generalist, and has experience taking a product from 0-1 product. About the Organization
EnGen offers an at-scale, AI-powered approach to English instruction, designed to solve a systemic access issue: Adult English learners now represent 1 in 10 working-age adults in the U.S., yet the workforce system serves the needs of just 4% of these workers.
A Certified B Corporation, EnGen is filling the gap by partnering with employers, adult educators, workforce development organizations, and state governments to connect job seekers and incumbent workers with English skills, career pathways, and employment in high-demand industries. EnGen's workforce-aligned approach addresses employers' recruitment and retention challenges and advances learners' economic mobility.
Position Overview
We're looking for a Full-Stack Software Engineer to help build the technology that empowers adult English learners to achieve their career goals. You'll develop and enhance our AI-powered learning platform using TypeScript/React on the frontend and Python/FastAPI on the backend.
We expect our engineers to be fluent in AI-assisted development — using tools like Cursor and Claude Code to write, review, and ship code faster and at higher quality. You should be comfortable directing AI to generate code, critically evaluating what it produces, and knowing when to write it yourself.

Full-Stack Development

  • Deliver production software across our TypeScript/React frontend and Python/FastAPI backend — whether writing code directly or steering AI tools to generate it

AI/LLM Integration

  • Build information extraction systems to analyze learner responses
  • Implement AI-powered features for conversation practice and multilingual support

Development Excellence

  • Write clean, well-tested code — and apply the same rigor when reviewing AI-generated output
  • Actively use and refine AI-assisted development workflows to improve your own productivity
  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and education specialists
  • Contribute to A/B testing frameworks and learning experience optimization

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional full-stack web development experience
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript, React, Python, and FastAPI
  • Experience integrating with LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) for classification, extraction, or personalization
  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) — and genuine comfort using them as part of your daily workflow
  • Experience with PostgreSQL and API design
  • Strong passion for EnGen's mission to help immigrants and refugees remove English as a barrier to career advancement

Preferred Qualifications

Who You Are

jobs.description:
Circuit Design Expert

Pay: $80–$130/hour

Location: Global, fully remote

Job Type: Contractor (~15 hours per week)

Schedule: Flexible—you choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired

We are looking for a highly skilled Circuit Design Expert to contribute to an AI training project involving electronic hardware, circuit simulation, programmatic EDA workflows, verification, and Python.

The work involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating engineering tasks related to analog, digital, power, mixed-signal, or RF circuits. A representative task may require interpreting circuit requirements, producing or modifying a netlist or hardware description, running simulations or verification tools from the command line, analyzing the resulting outputs, and determining whether the design satisfies its electrical and functional constraints.

This role requires experience with real circuit designs that were fabricated, shipped, integrated, or taped out. Simulation-only academic experience is not sufficient. Candidates must also have experience with tools that support programmatic or command-line workflows.

What You’ll Work On

  1. Design, analyze, and validate analog, digital, power, mixed-signal, or RF circuits.
  2. Translate electrical requirements into schematics, netlists, models, HDL, constraints, or simulation inputs.
  3. Run circuit simulation, synthesis, verification, or related workflows using command-line-accessible tools.
  4. Use Python to generate inputs, automate simulations, run parameter sweeps, control instruments, and analyze results.
  5. Evaluate voltage, current, power, gain, bandwidth, impedance, noise, timing, stability, thermal behavior, and other relevant outputs.
  6. Perform corner, tolerance, worst-case, transient, frequency-domain, or Monte Carlo analyses where appropriate.
  7. Compare simulated behavior with analytical calculations and physical measurements.
  8. Diagnose problems involving component selection, parasitics, layout, power integrity, signal integrity, thermal behavior, interfaces, or manufacturing.
  9. Review AI-generated circuit solutions and identify incorrect assumptions, invalid configurations, or unsupported conclusions.
  10. Develop reproducible reference solutions and automated verification checks.

Required Qualifications

  1. An MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline; or
  2. A BS in Electrical Engineering plus at least 1–2 years of relevant professional circuit-design experience.
  3. Meaningful experience designing analog, digital, power, mixed-signal, or RF circuits.
  4. Experience with designs that were fabricated, integrated, shipped, or taped out—not only simulated.
  5. Practical proficiency with Python.
  6. Experience with at least one EDA, circuit-simulation, PCB, HDL, synthesis, or verification tool that supports CLI, scripting, text-based inputs, or a programmatic API.
  7. Strong understanding of circuit behavior, component selection, tolerances, failure modes, and design trade-offs.
  8. Experience with hardware bring-up, laboratory validation, design verification, or post-fabrication debugging.
  9. Ability to explain circuit behavior and technical decisions clearly.

Relevant tools may include ngspice, Xyce, Yosys, Verilator, KiCad scripting, SPICE-compatible simulators, HDL simulators, synthesis tools, or equivalent programmatic EDA software. Experience with a comparable CLI-accessible tool is acceptable.

Relevant Python tools may include PySpice, NumPy, SciPy, pandas, Matplotlib, cocotb, instrument-control libraries, EDA APIs, or internally developed automation tools. No single library is mandatory.

Process

  1. Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.
  2. Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.
  3. Complete a technical assessment, if required.
  4. Complete the hiring manager review.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow.

Minimum submission requirements apply.

Start Timeline & Availability

  1. We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts who are ready to begin immediately. If selected, you will be expected to start your first task within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.
